sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glass(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return {(i,j):al[i][j] for i in range(34,44) for j in range(27,37)}
def air(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return sum(1 for i in range(25,33) for j in range(26,38) if al[i][j]=='B')
def pcol(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    from collections import Counter
    return dict(Counter(al[i][j] for i in range(25,32) for j in range(26,38) if al[i][j] in 'WpO'))
g0=glass(current_frame)
print('BEFORE: air',air(current_frame),'pcol',pcol(current_frame))
action(['SPACE'])
g1=glass(current_frame)
ch={k:(g0[k],g1[k]) for k in g0 if g0[k]!=g1[k]}
print('AFTER: air',air(current_frame),'pcol',pcol(current_frame),'changed',len(ch))
grid=[['.']*10 for _ in range(10)]
for (i,j) in ch: grid[i-34][j-27]=g1[(i,j)]
for r in grid: print(''.join(r))
print('level_completed',last_action_result.get('level_completed'),'level',current_frame.level)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glass(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return {(i,j):al[i][j] for i in range(34,44) for j in range(27,37)}
def air(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return sum(1 for i in range(25,33) for j in range(26,38) if al[i][j]=='B')
def pcol(f):
    al=f.ascii.split('\n')
    from collections import Counter
    return dict(Counter(al[i][j] for i in range(25,32) for j in range(26,38) if al[i][j] in 'WpO'))
g0=glass(current_frame)
print('BEFORE: air',air(current_frame),'pcol',pcol(current_frame))
action(['SPACE'])
g1=glass(current_frame)
ch={k:(g0[k],g1[k]) for k in g0 if g0[k]!=g1[k]}
print('AFTER: air',air(current_frame),'pcol',pcol(current_frame),'changed',len(ch))
grid=[['.']*10 for _ in range(10)]
for (i,j) in ch: grid[i-34][j-27]=g1[(i,j)]
for r in grid: print(''.join(r))
print('level_completed',last_action_result.get('level_completed'),'level',current_frame.level)
